future_engine_candidates: expo-av (deprecated track but still in Expo SDK; supports unified audio cross-platform)
expo-audio (newer, lighter, recommended for Expo SDK 51+)

loader_responsibility: preload only audio_keys flagged runtime_attached=true (none currently)
register audio with engine using audio_key as identifier
respect loop flag for ambient_loop entries
pause all audio on app background; resume on foreground
safety_constraints: NEVER load real money sound effects (cash register etc.) during pack experiments
NEVER autoplay audio without user interaction (mobile platform policy)
NEVER play audio on screens with VIP_LOCKED_V2 / BP_LOCKED_V2 / SHOP_LOCKED_V2 / ITEM_SHOP_LOCKED_V2 active
NEVER load placeholder audio in production release (replace_before_release=true check)
NEVER hardcode audio paths in runtime code; always go through manifest.json + audio_key resolution
FAIL SAFE: missing audio_key must be a silent no-op, never crash UI

surfaces_NOT_attached_in_this_pack: all locked surfaces (Shop, BP, VIP, Item Shop)
future_implementation_roadmap: Stage 1: PROJECT_AUDIO_RUNTIME_ENGINE_SELECTION_PACK — picks expo-av vs expo-audio vs react-native-sound; installs lib; adds smoke screen.
Stage 2: PROJECT_AUDIO_LOADER_AND_MANIFEST_CONSUMER_PACK — implements loader from manifest.json with audio_key lookup. Feature flag AUDIO_ENGINE_ENABLED stays false.
Stage 3: PROJECT_AUDIO_SETTINGS_UI_PACK — audio settings screen + master volume + per-category sliders + mute persistence.
Stage 4: PROJECT_AUDIO_UI_HOOKS_CANARY_PACK — attach test_ui_click/confirm/back/error to global UI events. Canary internal-only.
Stage 5: PROJECT_AUDIO_BATTLE_HOOKS_CANARY_PACK — attach battle stingers to combat phases. NO battle_engine modifications; pure observer pattern in frontend.
Stage 6: PROJECT_AUDIO_AMBIENT_LOOPS_CANARY_PACK — attach ambient_loop to idle screens with fade-in/out.
Stage 7: PROJECT_FINAL_AUDIO_BGM_SFX_KIT_PACK — replace all placeholders with final commissioned audio; flips AUDIO_ENGINE_ENABLED=true in production.
